# Unsigned community preview

This release contains the Windows x64 installer for DSH Desktop Community, an independent community distribution of the open-source DSH agent harness.

The installer is not code signed. Windows SmartScreen may display an unknown publisher warning. Verify the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before running it.

When this application and a local DSH Web installation use the same Windows account and `DSH_HOME`, they reuse the same Host sessions, settings, credentials references, profiles, plugins, presets, and user skills. Browser local storage, project files, cloud account history, damaged session logs, and cross-computer migration are not included.
